arxiv-2012-11185.title: Infrared image pedestrian target detection based on Yolov3 and migration learning
arxiv-2012-11185.creator: Geng Shengqi
arxiv-2012-11185.description: Abstract With the gradual application of infrared night vision vehicle assistance system in automatic driving, the accuracy of the collected infrared images of pedestrians is gradually improved. In this paper, the migration learning method is used to apply YOLOv3 model to realize pedestrian target detection in infrared images.

arxiv-2102-05696.title: The Physics of Galactic Winds Driven by Cosmic Rays I: Diffusion
arxiv-2102-05696.creator: Eliot Quataert, Todd A. Thompson, Yan-Fei Jiang(姜燕飞)
arxiv-2102-05696.description: Abstract The physics of Cosmic ray (CR) transport remains a key uncertainty in assessing whether CRs can produce galaxy-scale outflows consistent with observations. In this paper, we elucidate the physics of CR-driven galactic winds for CR transport dominated by diffusion. A companion paper considers CR streaming.

arxiv-2105-05938.title: The impact of the additional features on the performance of regression analysis: a case study on regression analysis of music signal
arxiv-2105-05938.creator: V. N. Aditya Datta Chivukula, Rupaj Kumar Nayak
arxiv-2105-05938.description: Abstract Machine learning techniques nowadays play a vital role in many burning issues of real-world problems when it involves data. In addition, when the task is complex, people are in dilemma in choosing deep learning techniques or going without them.

arxiv-2105-10110.title: Guidance and Teaching Network for Video Salient Object Detection
arxiv-2105-10110.creator: Yingxia Jiao, Xiao Wang, Yu-Cheng Chou, Shouyuan Yang, Ge-Peng Ji, Rong Zhu, Ge Gao
arxiv-2105-10110.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yingxia Jiao, Xiao Wang, Yu-Cheng Chou, Shouyuan Yang, Ge-Peng Ji, Rong Zhu, Ge Gao. Owing to the difficulties of mining spatial-temporal cues, the existing approaches for video salient object detection (VSOD) are limited in understanding complex and noisy scenarios, and often fail in inferring prominent objects.

arxiv-2203-09254.title: On flag-transitive 2 2 - ( k 2 , k , λ ) (k^{2},k,\lambda) designs with λ | k \lambda\mid k . Thanks: Corresponding author: Alessandro Montinaro
arxiv-2203-09254.creator: Alessandro Montinaro and Eliana Francot
arxiv-2203-09254.description: Abstract . It is shown that, apart from the smallest Ree group, a flag-transitive automorphism group G G of a 2 2 - ( k 2 , k , λ ) (k^{2},k,\lambda) design 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , with λ | k \lambda\mid k , is either an affine group or an almost simple classical group.

arxiv-2301-06498.title: Bottom-up growth of monolayer honeycomb SiC
arxiv-2301-06498.creator: C. M. Polley, H. Fedderwitz, T. Balasubramanian, A. A. Zakharov, R. Yakimova, O. Bäcke, J. Ekman, S. P. Dash, S. Kubatkin, S. Lara-Avila
arxiv-2301-06498.description: Abstract The long theorized two-dimensional allotrope of SiC has remained elusive amid the exploration of graphenelike honeycomb structured monolayers. It is anticipated to possess a large direct band gap (2.5 eV), ambient stability, and chemical versatility. While s ​ p 2 sp^{2} bonding between silicon and carbon is energetically favorable, only disordered nanoflakes have been reported to date.

arxiv-2306-11354.title: Exoplanet Interior Retrievals: core masses and metallicities from atmospheric abundances 2023 Exoplanet Interior Retrievals: core masses and metallicities from atmospheric abundances – References
arxiv-2306-11354.creator: S. Bloot, Y. Miguel, M. Bazot, S. Howard
arxiv-2306-11354.description: Abstract The mass and distribution of metals in the interiors of exoplanets are essential for constraining their formation and evolution processes. Nevertheless, with only masses and radii measured, the determination of exoplanet interior structures is degenerate, and so far simplified assumptions have mostly been used to derive planetary metallicities.

arxiv-2310-18770.title: Leveraging Multimodal Features and Item-level User Feedback for Bundle Construction Conference: March 4–8, 2023; Mérida, México;
arxiv-2310-18770.creator: Yunshan Ma, Xiaohao Liu, Yinwei Wei, Zhulin Tao, Xiang Wang, Tat-Seng Chua
arxiv-2310-18770.description: Abstract . Automatic bundle construction is a crucial prerequisite step in various bundle-aware online services. Previous approaches are mostly designed to model the bundling strategy of existing bundles. However, it is hard to acquire large-scale well-curated bundle dataset, especially for those platforms that have not offered bundle services before.

arxiv-2311-05874.title: Testing Dependency of Unlabeled Databases
arxiv-2311-05874.creator: Vered Paslev Wasim Huleihel
arxiv-2311-05874.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vered Paslev Wasim Huleihel. In this paper, we investigate the problem of deciding whether two random databases 𝖷 ∈ 𝒳 n × d \mathsf{X}\in{\cal X}^{n\times d} and 𝖸 ∈ 𝒴 n × d \mathsf{Y}\in{\cal Y}^{n\times d} are statistically dependent or not.

arxiv-2404-16637.title: Zero-Shot Distillation for Image Encoders: How to Make Effective Use of Synthetic Data
arxiv-2404-16637.creator: Niclas Popp¹ , ², Jan Hendrik Metzen², Matthias Hein¹
arxiv-2404-16637.description: Abstract Multi-modal foundation models such as CLIP have showcased impressive zero-shot capabilities. However, their applicability in resource-constrained environments is limited due to their large number of parameters and high inference time. While existing approaches have scaled down the entire CLIP architecture, we focus on training smaller variants of the image encoder, which suffices for efficient zero-shot classification.

arxiv-2405-01193.title: On Hyperbolicity of Spirallike Circularlike domain
arxiv-2405-01193.creator: Sanjoy Chatterjee and Golam Mostafa Mondal
arxiv-2405-01193.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove that a spirallike circularlike domain is Kobayashi hyperbolic if and only if its core is empty. In particular, we show that such a domain is Kobayashi hyperbolic if and only if it is (biholomorphic to) a bounded domain. We also propose a problem in this area.

arxiv-2409-09926.title: Disentangling the Impact of Quasiparticles and Two-Level Systems on the Statistics of Superconducting Qubit Lifetime
arxiv-2409-09926.creator: Shaojiang Zhu, Xinyuan You, Ugur Alyanak, Mustafa Bal, Francesco Crisa, Sabrina Garattoni, Andrei Lunin, Roman Pilipenko, Akshay Murthy, Alexander Romanenko, Anna Grassellino
arxiv-2409-09926.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shaojiang Zhu, Xinyuan You, Ugur Alyanak, Mustafa Bal, Francesco Crisa, Sabrina Garattoni, Andrei Lunin, Roman Pilipenko, Akshay Murthy, Alexander Romanenko, Anna Grassellino. Temporal fluctuations in the superconducting qubit lifetime, T 1 T_{1} , bring about additional challenges in building a fault-tolerant quantum computer.

arxiv-2503-10912.title: JPEG Compliant Compression for Both Human and Machine, A Report
arxiv-2503-10912.creator: Linfeng Ye
arxiv-2503-10912.description: Abstract Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have become an integral part of our daily lives, especially in vision-related applications. However, the conventional lossy image compression algorithms are primarily designed for the Human Vision System (HVS), which can non-trivially compromise the DNNs’ validation accuracy after compression, as noted in [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2504-08644.title: Reverberation-based Features for Sound Event Localization and Detection with Distance Estimation
arxiv-2504-08644.creator: Davide Berghi, Philip J. B. Jackson
arxiv-2504-08644.description: Abstract Sound event localization and detection (SELD) involves predicting active sound event classes over time while estimating their positions. The localization subtask in SELD is usually treated as a direction of arrival estimation problem, ignoring source distance. Only recently, SELD was extended to 3D by incorporating distance estimation, enabling the prediction of sound event positions in 3D space (3D SELD).

arxiv-2509-16996.title: Radiation Mediated Shock and Planar Shock Breakout in the Presence of Atomic Transition Lines
arxiv-2509-16996.creator: Jonathan Morag
arxiv-2509-16996.description: Abstract We numerically study fast Newtonian radiation mediated shocks (RMS - v / c ≲ 0.2 v/c\lesssim 0.2 ) in two simplified problems within the context of supernova shock breakout; (1) An RMS traveling in a uniform medium, and (2) an RMS escaping a powerlaw density profile in planar geometry ( ρ ∝ x n \rho\propto x^{n} ).

plos-pone-0004623.creator: Challagundla K. Babu, Kanitta Suwansrinon, Gary D. Bren et al.
plos-pone-0004623.description: PLOS ONE research article. HIV infected patients have an increased susceptibility to liver disease due to Hepatitis B Virus (HBV), Hepatitis C Virus (HCV), alcoholic, and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Clinically, this results in limited options for antiretroviral therapy and accelerated rates of liver dis

plos-pone-0005071.creator: Yuji Kajiwara, Afia Akram, Pavel Katsel et al.
plos-pone-0005071.description: PLOS ONE research article. The Alzheimer disease (AD) amyloid protein precursor (APP) can bind the FE65 adaptor protein and this complex can regulate gene expression. We carried out yeast two-hybrid studies with a PTB domain of FE65, focusing on those genes that might be involved in nuclear signaling, and

pmc-10711004.title: Association of serum phosphate and changes in serum phosphate with 28-day mortality in septic shock from MIMIC-IV database
pmc-10711004.creator: Wenbin Nan, Qiong Huang, Jinfa Wan, Zhenyu Peng
pmc-10711004.description: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between serum phosphate levels, changes in serum phosphate levels, and 28-day mortality in patients with septic shock. In this retrospective study, data were collected from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) database between 2008 and 2019. Patients were divided into three groups according to the tertiles of serum phosphate levels.

pmc-10924745.title: Fast and Accurate Maximum-Likelihood Estimation of Multi-Type Birth–Death Epidemiological Models from Phylogenetic Trees
pmc-10924745.creator: Anna Zhukova, Frédéric Hecht, Yvon Maday, Olivier Gascuel
pmc-10924745.description: Multi-type birth–death (MTBD) models are phylodynamic analogies of compartmental models in classical epidemiology. They serve to infer such epidemiological parameters as the average number of secondary infections Re and the infectious time from a phylogenetic tree (a genealogy of pathogen sequences). The representatives of this model family focus on various aspects of pathogen epidemics.

pmc-11311052.title: Sustainable Fish Meal-Free Diets for Gilthead Sea Bream (Sparus aurata): Integrated Biomarker Response to Assess the Effects on Growth Performance, Lipid Metabolism, Antioxidant Defense and Immunological Status
pmc-11311052.creator: Ana M Fernandes, Josep Àlvar Calduch-Giner, Gabriella V Pereira, Ana Teresa Gonçalves, Jorge Dias, Johan Johansen, Tomé Silva, Fernando Naya-Català, Carla Piazzon, Ariadna Sitjà-Bobadilla, Benjamin Costas, Luís E C Conceição, Jorge M O Fernandes, Jaume Pérez-Sánchez, Seunghyung Lee
pmc-11311052.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryThe present study shows how different combinations of eco-efficient ingredients can be considered reliable solutions for European aquaculture production. For this purpose, three different formulations were designed and tested in a 77-day gilthead sea bream trial. All diets supported similar growth rates, but the diet without poultry meal and processed animal proteins as the main fish meal replacer (NOPAP diet) shaped better nutrient utilization with an overall improvement of biomarkers of physiological condition.

pmc-11425595.title: 140 Development of public facing physical activity messages to accompany the updated National Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour Guidelines for Ireland
pmc-11425595.creator: Chloë Williamson, Dylan Power, Elaine Murtagh
pmc-11425595.description: PurposeOne assumption that has been made previously is that physical activity (PA) guidelines themselves double up as effective PA messages, yet PA guideline knowledge remains low. This study aimed to develop public-facing messages to accompany the Updated National Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour Guidelines for Ireland (forthcoming – March 2024).

pmc-11566878.title: Mapping grey matter and cortical thickness alterations associated with subjective cognitive decline and mild cognitive impairment among rural-dwelling older adults in China: A population-based study
pmc-11566878.creator: Ziwei Chen, Qianqian Xie, Jiafeng Wang, Yan Wang, Huisi Zhang, Chunyan Li, Yongxiang Wang, Lin Cong, Shi Tang, Tingting Hou, Lin Song, Yifeng Du, Chengxuan Qiu
pmc-11566878.description: Highlights•Structural brain alterations were analyzed using VBM and SBM among rural-dwelling older adults in China.•Reduced cortical thickness was detected in six clusters of brain regions for MCI and three clusters for SCD.•MCI, but not SCD, was associated with reduced GMV in four clusters of brain regions.

pmc-11757289.title: The relationship between psychological abuse, athlete satisfaction, eating disorder and self-harm indicators in elite athletes
pmc-11757289.creator: Erin Willson, Stephanie Buono, Gretchen Kerr, Ashley Stirling
pmc-11757289.description: IntroductionPsychological abuse continues to be the most frequently reported type of maltreatment among athletes leading to negative mental health such as low mood and self-esteem, increased anxiety, self-harm, and eating disorders. Preliminary evidence suggests athlete satisfaction can influence the perceived outcomes associated with psychological abuse.

pmc-12413085.title: Spatiotemporal coordination of reovirus peripheral core replication to perinuclear whole virus assembly
pmc-12413085.creator: Justine Kniert, Dante Terino, Heather E. Eaton, Qi Feng Lin, Shiau-Yin Wu, Hilmar Strickfaden, Maya Shmulevitz, Sonja Best, Sonja Best, Sonja Best
pmc-12413085.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Reoviruses coordinate their replication and assembly through intricate spatial and temporal compartmentalization within host cells. In this study, we elucidate the dynamics of mammalian orthoreovirus (reovirus) core replication and viral particle assembly. Using high-resolution immunofluorescence confocal microscopy, we tracked input cores and de novo cores, revealing that input cores initially form peripheral, OC-negative factories that migrate inward while seeding independent peripheral factories.

pmc-12653476.title: Precision in Practice: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Intraoperative Neurophysiological Monitoring for Optimizing Outcomes in Extramedullary Spinal Cord Tumor Resection
pmc-12653476.creator: Raja Narendra Divakar Addanki, Benjamin B Lee, Katherine M Anetakis, Jeffrey R Balzer, Parthasarathy D Thirumala, Kai-Uwe Lewandrowski
pmc-12653476.description: Background/Objectives: Intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring (IONM) is used to detect and prevent neurological injury during extramedullary spinal cord tumor (EMSCT) resection, but its diagnostic accuracy lacks systematic validation with recent evidence. This meta-analysis evaluates the performance of somatosensory evoked potentials (SSEPs), transcranial motor evoked potentials (TcMEPs), and multimodal (SSEP + TcMEP) IONM in predicting deficits during EMSCT resections.

pmc-12672752.title: Persistent primitive lateral basilovertebral anastomosis-rethinking vertebrobasilar junction fenestration
pmc-12672752.creator: George Triantafyllou, Panagiotis Papadopoulos-Manolarakis, Nikolaos-Achilleas Arkoudis, George Velonakis, Alexandros Samolis, Maria Piagkou
pmc-12672752.description: PurposeTo describe and analyze two rare cases of arterial rings at the vertebrobasilar junction (VBJ), likely representing persistent segments of the primitive lateral basilovertebral anastomosis (PLBVA), and to explore their embryological origin and clinical significance.Materials and methodsTwo morphological arterial variants were identified during a retrospective review of computed tomography angiography (CTA) scans from 505 patients.

pmc-12708848.title: Plasmid2MC: efficient cell-free generation of high-purity minicircle DNA for genome editing in mammalian cells
pmc-12708848.creator: Roman Teo Oliynyk, Ahmed Mahas, Emil Karpinski, George M Church
pmc-12708848.description: DNA plasmids are widely used for delivering proteins and RNA in genome editing. However, their bacterial components can lead to inactivation, cell toxicity, and reduced efficiency compared to minicircle DNA (mcDNA), which lacks such bacterial sequences. Existing commercial kits that recombine plasmids into mcDNA within proprietary bacterial strains are labor-intensive, yield inconsistent results, and often produce endotoxin-contaminated low-quality mcDNA.

pmc-12752212.title: Associations between axial length and optical coherence tomography angiography biomarkers
pmc-12752212.creator: Jessica Wing Ka Lau, Shing Chuen Chow, Ming Ming Zhu, Pun Yuet Lam, Kendrick Co Shih, Nicholas Siu Kay Fung
pmc-12752212.description: PurposeTo determine the associations between axial length (AL) and optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA)-based eye-related parameters.MethodsA prospective cross-sectional study of the right eye of 6953 individuals between the ages 50 and 97, with a range of AL from 19.1 to 31.7 mm was performed.

pmc-12996654.title: Prognostic significance of minimal extrathyroidal extension in differentiated thyroid carcinoma: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12996654.creator: Beatriz G Cavalheiro, Vergilius José Furtado de Araújo Filho, Leandro Luongo Matos, Ana Kober Leite, Claudio Roberto Cernea, Luiz Paulo Kowalski
pmc-12996654.description: Highlights•Minimal ETE is associated with adverse risk features in thyroid carcinoma.•Patients with minimal ETE had higher recurrence rates in univariate analysis.•Minimal ETE was not an independent predictor of poor outcomes.•Risk stratification should not rely solely on the presence of minimal ETE.Keywords: Thyroid neoplasms, Papillary carcinoma, Prognosis, Recurrence, Extracapsular extension Introduction Differentiated Thyroid Carcinomas (DTC) are the most prevalent endocrine neoplasms.

pmc-13185439.title: AMPK promotes TFEB transcriptional activity through dephosphorylation at both MTORC1-dependent and -independent sites
pmc-13185439.creator: Florentina Negoita, Conchita Fraguas Bringas, Kristina Hellberg, Katarzyna M Luda, Hongling Liu, Zhiyuan Li, Joyceline Cuenco, Jin-Feng Zhao, Gajanan Sathe, Ian G Ganley, Gopal P Sapkota, Kei Sakamoto
pmc-13185439.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). TFEB (transcription factor EB) is a critical regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, macroautophagy/autophagy and energy homeostasis through controlling expression of genes belonging to the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation network. AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) has been reported to phosphorylate TFEB at three conserved C-terminal serine residues (S466, S467, S469) and these phosphorylation events were reported to be essential for transcriptional activation of TFEB. In sharp contrast to this proposition, we demonstrate that AMPK activation leads to the dephosphorylation of the C-terminal sites.

pmc-13329545.title: Minimally Invasive Surgery: A Systematic Review of Laparoscopic and Robotic Techniques Across Common Surgical Procedures
pmc-13329545.creator: Menpara Krishna Kishorbhai, Jegan Mohan S, Karthikhaeyan TR, Srishti Mohapatra, Roshan Chanchlani, Soham V Shah
pmc-13329545.description: Minimally invasive surgery has transformed surgical practice by reducing operative trauma, postoperative pain, and recovery time compared with open approaches. While conventional laparoscopy remains widely used across specialties, technical limitations such as restricted instrument articulation and limited visualization have driven the adoption of robotic-assisted surgery.

pmc-13336563.title: CCL3 and IL‐7 Synergistically Enhance CAR‐T Efficacy in Solid Tumors
pmc-13336563.creator: Huanpeng Chen, Xiaoyun Luo, Huixin Gao, Yujing Ke, Yu Zhan, Xiaoting Xu, Xiaoxiao Xiong, Fengjiao Wei, Si Yang, Zhonghua Liu, Bolan Yu, Zhaofeng Huang, Yingjie Bian

pmc-13350149.title: A nomogram integrating a novel uterine isthmus ratio (APTUIR), sonographic signs and clinical symptoms for predicting posterior deep endometriosis
pmc-13350149.creator: Shun Yang, Yitong He, Chunchun Jin, Meifang Deng, Yuyu Zhou, Kaiju Luo, Lvhuan Qiu, Yanling Bei, Qiuxiang Chen
pmc-13350149.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to propose a novel, reproducible transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) measurement—anterior–posterior wall thickness of the uterine isthmus ratio (APTUIR)—and to construct a nomogram model integrating this parameter with other ultrasound assessments and clinical symptoms for predicting the risk of posterior pelvic deep endometriosis (DE).

pmc-13674096.creator: Rachel Johnstone, Jenna Smarzinski, Sahithi Bhavana, Robert Vande Kappelle, Wasim Khan, Brandon Smith, Robert Stewart, Tara Karamlou
pmc-13674096.description: APVR, avoiding posterior dissection but requiring vigilance for coronary anomalies. A, Illustration of anatomy. B, Preoperative 3-dimensional volume-rendered reconstruction.
